typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	Email_Failure as string (),
	Email_Success as string (),
	ENV as string (),
	FileName as string (),
	FilePrefix as string (),
	FinalFileResultQry as string (),
	OutboundFilePath as string (),
	RunLogID as integer ()
}

source(output(
		ResultSet as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'BEGIN  DECLARE @RunLogID_StateResponse INT = 9	 	, @Source Varchar(100) = \'FACETS\'  DROP TABLE IF EXISTS  #CreateResponseFile CREATE TABLE #CreateResponseFile ( 	[TRACKING_ID] varchar(30),[MCE_CLAIM_ID] varchar(30),[FORM_TYPE] varchar(4),[BILL_TYPE] varchar(4),[CLAIM_STATUS] varchar(2),[CLAIM_REASON] varchar(30),[CLAIM_PROV_ID] varchar(15),[CLAIM_MEM_ID] varchar(25),[PAT_CTRL_NUM] varchar(30),[HEADER_BILLED_AMT] decimal(13,2),[STATUS_DETAIL_LINE] varchar(2),[REASON_DETAIL_LINE] varchar(30),[CLAIM_START_DT] varchar(10),[CLAIM_END_DT] varchar(10),[CLAIM_PAID_AMT] decimal(13,2),[CLAIM_LINE_NUM] int,[CLAIM_SERV_CODE] varchar(5),[MOD_CODE1] varchar(2),[MOD_CODE2] varchar(2),[REV_CODE] varchar(4),[SERV_UNITS] int,[CLAIM_DETAIL_AMT] decimal(13,2),[CLAIM_DETAIL_PAID_AMT] decimal(13,2),[REASON_FOR_REJECTION] varchar(60) )   INSERT INTO #CreateResponseFile SELECT  A.TRACKING_ID, A.MCE_CLAIM_ID, A.FORM_TYPE,					 A.BILL_TYPE, A.CLAIM_STATUS,					 A.CLAIM_REASON,					 A.CLAIM_PROV_ID,					 A.CLAIM_MEM_ID,					 A.PAT_CTRL_NUM, A.HEADER_BILLED_AMT,					 A.STATUS_DETAIL_LINE,					 A.REASON_DETAIL_LINE,					 A.CLAIM_START_DT,					 A.CLAIM_END_DT,					 A.CLAIM_PAID_AMT,					 A.CLAIM_LINE_NUM,					 A.CLAIM_SERV_CODE,					 A.MOD_CODE1,					 A.MOD_CODE2,					 A.REV_CODE,					 A.SERV_UNITS,					 A.CLAIM_DETAIL_AMT,					 A.CLAIM_DETAIL_PAID_AMT,					 A.REASON_FOR_REJECTION		 FROM  [EXTRACT].[OH_CH_PendedPaidClaimsDetail_Response] A					 INNER JOIN (SELECT TRACKING_ID, MCE_CLAIM_ID, CLAIM_LINE_NUM, [DATA_SOURCE] FROM [EXTRACT].[OH_CH_PendedPaidClaims_State] GROUP BY TRACKING_ID, MCE_CLAIM_ID, CLAIM_LINE_NUM, [DATA_SOURCE]) B					 	ON B.TRACKING_ID = A.TRACKING_ID 				 	AND B.MCE_CLAIM_ID = A.MCE_CLAIM_ID		 	AND B.CLAIM_LINE_NUM = A.CLAIM_LINE_NUM		 where a.RunLogID = @RunLogID_StateResponse		 AND B.[DATA_SOURCE] = @Source     /* Outbound File Format */  DECLARE @V_HEADER_FIELD_LIST VARCHAR(MAX), @V_HEADER_FIELD_LIST_qry NVARCHAR(MAX), 		@V_DATA_FIELD_LIST VARCHAR(MAX), @V_DATA_FIELD_LIST_qry NVARCHAR(MAX), 		@SQL VARCHAR(MAX), 		@TableName VARCHAR(100) = \'#CreateResponseFile\',  		@Delimiter VARCHAR(1)   SELECT @Delimiter =  CASE WHEN @Source = \'FACETS\' THEN \',\' ELSE \'|\' END     SET @V_HEADER_FIELD_LIST_qry = 	N\'SELECT @V_HEADER_FIELD_LIST = STUFF( 			(  SELECT \'\'\'+@Delimiter+\'\'\' + C.name + \'\'\'\' FROM TEMPDB.sys.columns C WHERE C.object_id = T.object_id ORDER BY C.column_id FOR XML PATH(\'\'\'\') 		), 1, 1, \'\'\'\') 	FROM TEMPDB.sys.tables T 	WHERE T.OBJECT_ID = ( SELECT OBJECT_ID(\'\'TEMPDB..\'+@TableName+\'\'\'))\'  EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @V_HEADER_FIELD_LIST_qry , N\'@V_HEADER_FIELD_LIST NVARCHAR(MAX) OUTPUT\', @V_HEADER_FIELD_LIST OUTPUT;    SET @V_DATA_FIELD_LIST_qry = 	N\'SELECT @V_DATA_FIELD_LIST = STUFF( 			( SELECT \'\' + \'\'\'\'@Delimiter\'\'\'\' + ISNULL(CONVERT(VARCHAR(MAX),[\'\' + C.name + \'\']),\'\'\'\'\'\'\'\')\'\' FROM TEMPDB.sys.columns C 		WHERE C.object_id = T.object_id ORDER BY C.column_id FOR XML PATH(\'\'\'\') 		), 1, 18, \'\'\'\') 	FROM TEMPDB.sys.tables T 	WHERE T.OBJECT_ID = ( SELECT OBJECT_ID(\'\'TEMPDB..\'+@TableName+\'\'\'))\'  EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @V_DATA_FIELD_LIST_qry , N\'@V_DATA_FIELD_LIST NVARCHAR(MAX) OUTPUT\', @V_DATA_FIELD_LIST OUTPUT; SET @V_DATA_FIELD_LIST = REPLACE(@V_DATA_FIELD_LIST, \'@Delimiter\', @Delimiter)   IF OBJECT_ID(\'tempdb..#CreateResponseFile_RESULTSET\') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #CreateResponseFile_RESULTSET CREATE TABLE #CreateResponseFile_RESULTSET (RecordType INT, ResultSet VARCHAR(MAX))  SET @SQL = \' INSERT INTO #CreateResponseFile_RESULTSET SELECT 1 RecordType, \'\'\' + @V_HEADER_FIELD_LIST + \'\'\' as resultset  INSERT INTO #CreateResponseFile_RESULTSET SELECT 2 RecordType, \' + @V_DATA_FIELD_LIST + \' as resultset FROM  #CreateResponseFile\'  EXEC (@SQL)  INSERT INTO #CreateResponseFile_RESULTSET  SELECT 3 RecordType, MAX(StateResponse_Status) + @Delimiter + CAST( COUNT(1) AS VARCHAR(10)) as resultset FROM  #CreateResponseFile INNER JOIN [EXTRACT].[OH_CH_PendedPaidClaimsTrailer_Response]  ON 1=1 AND RunLogID = @RunLogID_StateResponse	  SELECT ResultSet FROM #CreateResponseFile_RESULTSET ORDER BY RecordType  END',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		ResultSet as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		ResultSet)) ~> FFStateExtractFileOutbound
